title: decisions.jsonl — gate + flag + walkthrough audit record (TECH_SPEC §3.6, NFR-03)
description: One object per line; append-only. Every gate, flag and walkthrough decision: who, when, outcome, rationale. Four record kinds keyed by `kind`. Field shapes match the writers in core/scripts/decisions.py. `disposition` is the ADR-008 addition (D-A16/D-A17): the operator's call on an escalated enrichment finding, and — uniquely among the ledger files — its RATIONALE, which is what lets someone at G2 ask "why does §13 say this now?" and get an answer. Records decisions only — never artifact content (FR-XS-05); a finding is referenced by `finding_id` into enrichment.json, never inlined.

call.description: The operator's call on an escalated finding (D-A16/D-A17) — mirrors telemetry.schema.json's `call`. This is the FINDING disposition, not the D-A12 SOURCE disposition.

target.description: Where the dispositioned finding landed — an SI section ref ("§16", "§14", "§7", "§8", "§12", "§17"). Absent on `reject`, whose finding is dropped rather than placed.
